subject: Companies Registry Notice for Lotus Garden Trading Limited
body:
Dear Ms Karen Tsang,

We have received a letter for Lotus Garden Trading Limited from the Companies Registry. It is a notice demanding payment of an outstanding late registration fee balance of HK$765 for the 2026 annual return on or before 21 November 2026.

A scan of the letter is attached for your reference. Please let us know if you would like our assistance in arranging the payment.

Best regards,
CWC CPA
